reviews.body:
### 🟢 Approval recommended The change forwards the prepared SSL configuration to the Cassandra client and includes regression coverage for both SSL and non-SSL connection behavior, with no active review issues identified. **No open issues** 🎉
What changed in this PR This PR forwards the API-prepared SSL configuration to the Cassandra client and adds regression tests for SSL and non-SSL connections. Encrypted client keys still require mapping the configured password to Node TLS's `passphrase` option. **Changes:** - Added the `ssl` connection parameter to the Cassandra backend driver. - Passed SSL settings to `cassandra.Client` as `sslOptions`. - Added mocked regression tests for SSL propagation and disabled TLS behavior. | File | Description | | ---- | ----------- | | plugins/​dbgate-plugin-cassandra/​src/​backend/​driver.test.cjs | Adds mocked regression tests verifying SSL options are forwarded and omitted when SSL is not configured. | | plugins/​dbgate-plugin-cassandra/​src/​backend/​driver.js | Accepts the prepared SSL configuration and forwards it to the Cassandra client as `sslOptions`. |
Review effort: Lite
